MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Echo Show 8 and Smart Plug feel like useful additions to my Fire TV setup because they add a screen for video calls and voice control for a lamp.",
    "Home monitoring and recording accessories fit my recent camera purchases; the WYZE camera and memory card relate to actual interests, even though I would not buy them immediately."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Another HD Fire TV Stick adds little because I already have a 4K Stick and a Fire TV television; sharing the same product line does not make it a useful next purchase.",
    "Echo Auto, USB-C cables, and a large pack of cable clips do not address a current need suggested by my home entertainment and camera purchases.",
    "The Show 5 and Echo Dot fit my interests, but I would choose the Show 8 first; I do not currently need several devices with overlapping uses."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My use of Alexa-enabled entertainment devices seems to have been taken as interest in almost any Alexa product, including one for the car.",
    "My electronics purchases seem to have been treated as a broad need for more gadgets and accessories, without a clear connection to what I need next."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Recent purchases can mean a need has already been met: I want to try my new Blink camera before considering another monitoring system.",
    "I care about what an addition enables, such as video calls or lamp control, more than whether it resembles something I already own.",
    "Accessories need to match my devices and an actual need; I would verify the memory card's compatibility and whether my camcorder bundle already covers storage."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my interest in connected home entertainment and cameras, but overlook whether a product adds a useful capability or repeats a need I have already met."
}
